program.description.de: CPU- und GPU-Temperatur in der Taskleiste; ein Klick aufs Icon zeigt fast alle Hardware-Werte (hardware_monitor).
program.description.en: CPU and GPU temperature in the taskbar; clicking an icon shows almost all hardware values.

page.autostart.text.de: Startet den Hardware-Monitor beim Anmelden über die Aufgabenplanung (mit Adminrechten, ohne Nachfrage).
page.autostart.text.en: Starts the Hardware Monitor at sign-in via Task Scheduler (with admin rights, without asking).

page.task.missing.de: Aufgabe „{task}“ gibt es noch nicht. „Aufgabe einrichten“ legt sie an (Windows fragt einmal nach Adminrechten).
page.task.missing.en: Task "{task}" doesn't exist yet. "Set up task" creates it (Windows asks for admin rights once).

page.task.other_location.de:
Aufgabe „{task}“ startet einen anderen Ort: {target} {arguments}
„Aufgabe aktualisieren“ stellt sie auf diesen Ordner um (oder Setup.exe erneut ausführen).
page.task.other_location.en:
Task "{task}" starts a different location: {target} {arguments}
"Update task" points it to this folder (or run Setup.exe again).

page.task.setting_up.de: Richte Aufgabe ein … (bitte die Windows-Abfrage bestätigen)
page.task.setting_up.en: Setting up task … (please confirm the Windows prompt)

page.refresh.text.de: Wie oft gemessen wird. Seltener = sparsamer. Die Icons lesen nur CPU und GPU, das geöffnete Fenster die Geräte des gewählten Tabs.
page.refresh.text.en: How often values are measured. Less often = more efficient. The icons only read CPU and GPU, the open window reads the devices of the selected tab.

page.efficiency.info.de:
Effizienzmodus von Windows 11 (grünes Blatt im Task-Manager):

•  Automatisch: an, solange das Detailfenster zu ist – beim Öffnen aus, damit es flüssig bleibt.
•  Immer an: auch bei offenem Fenster. Am sparsamsten, das Fenster reagiert evtl. träger.
•  Aus: läuft immer mit normaler Priorität.
page.efficiency.info.en:
Windows 11 efficiency mode (green leaf in Task Manager):

•  Automatic: on while the detail window is closed – off when it opens, so it stays smooth.
•  Always on: even with the window open. Most efficient, the window may respond more slowly.
•  Off: always runs at normal priority.

page.sensor.text.de: Eigene Namen kannst du eintippen (siehe hardware_monitor.py --list). Gibt es den Sensor nicht, wird automatisch gewählt.
page.sensor.text.en: You can type in other sensor names (see hardware_monitor.py --list). If the sensor doesn't exist, one is chosen automatically.

page.colors.text.de: Farbe der Temperaturen – getrennt, weil CPUs unter Last deutlich heißer werden dürfen als Grafikkarten. Mainboard und Laufwerke im Detailfenster richten sich nach der CPU.
page.colors.text.en: Temperature colors – separate, because CPUs may get considerably hotter under load than graphics cards. Motherboard and drives in the detail window use the CPU values.

page.privacy.text.en: Hides serial numbers, MAC addresses, the processor ID and the computer name in the detail window – on screen and when copying they appear as ████████, e.g. for screenshots or forum posts. The window title then only says "Hardware Monitor" instead of the program path, which can contain your Windows user name. You can also switch it in the detail window (next to "● Live") and in the right-click menu of the icons.

page.privacy.switch.en: Hide serial numbers, MAC addresses and computer name

page.power.text.en: Adds up how much energy the whole PC uses and what it costs. Most power supplies can't report what they draw (only a few with a USB cable), so it's estimated: CPU and graphics card are measured, plus a fixed value for the rest of the PC (motherboard, RAM, drives, fans, USB devices), divided by the efficiency of the power supply. A laptop running on battery measures it itself. Logged only while the Hardware Monitor runs – with autostart that's practically the whole time the PC is on; while it sleeps nothing is counted. Saved in data\hardware_monitor_energy.json.

page.power.calibrate.en: Other components: about 30–60 W for a desktop PC (more with many drives, fans or RGB lighting). Efficiency: 80 PLUS Bronze/Gold power supplies reach about 85–90 %. If you have an energy meter for the socket, compare it with "Now" in the detail window and adjust "Other components" until both match.

page.power.delete.question.en: Delete all logged power consumption data? This can't be undone.

page.power.delete_failed.en: Couldn't delete the data – details in the log

page.power.not_running.en: The Hardware Monitor isn't running – start it first

page.power.nothing_yet.en: Logging is on – nothing counted yet

page.fans.text.en: Curves for the graphics card fans and the motherboard fan headers – like in MSI Afterburner, e.g. to make the PC quieter. You set them in the detail window, tab "Fans": per fan Auto (as without this program), a curve or a fixed speed. Safety: from the red temperature limit (section Display) on, a controlled fan always runs at 100 %; without a temperature and when quitting, every fan is handed back to the graphics card or the BIOS. Only if the Hardware Monitor is killed (Task Manager, crash) does a fan keep its last speed until Windows restarts – the hardware then protects itself by throttling. "Reset everything" (Advanced) sets all fans back to Auto.

page.detail_window.text.de: Welche Werte im Detailfenster stehen, legst du in detail_window_content.py fest – eine Zeile pro Wert. Änderungen erscheinen beim nächsten Öffnen des Fensters, alle Sensornamen zeigt „hardware_monitor.py --list“.
page.detail_window.text.en: Which values the detail window shows is set in detail_window_content.py – one line per value. Changes appear the next time the window opens; "hardware_monitor.py --list" shows all sensor names.

window.hint.de: Klick auf einen Wert oder Gerätenamen kopiert ihn. Mehrere Zeilen: markieren (ziehen, Strg- oder Umschalt+Klick, Strg+A) und mit Strg+C kopieren. Maus über einen Wert erklärt ihn.
window.hint.en: Click a value or device name to copy it. Several rows: select them (drag, Ctrl+click or Shift+click, Ctrl+A) and copy with Ctrl+C. Hover over a value for an explanation.

window.gear.de: Einstellungen des Hardware-Monitors – öffnet seine Seite in der Toolbox (startet sie, falls nötig).
window.gear.en: Hardware Monitor settings – opens its page in the Toolbox (starts it if needed).

window.privacy.on_help.en: Privacy mode is on: serial numbers, MAC addresses, the processor ID and the computer name are hidden (████████) – on screen, when copying and in the window title. Click to show them again.

window.privacy.off_help.en: Privacy mode is off. Click to hide serial numbers, MAC addresses, the processor ID and the computer name – on screen and when copying, e.g. for screenshots or forum posts.

window.privacy.hidden.en: Hidden by privacy mode – a click copies ████████, not the real value.

window.no_sensors.de: Keine passenden Sensoren – die Namen zeigt „python hardware_monitor.py --list“.
window.no_sensors.en: No matching sensors – "python hardware_monitor.py --list" shows the names.

window.content_error.en: Error in detail_window_content.py (details in the log): {error}

window.toolbox_error.de: Toolbox ließ sich nicht öffnen – Details im Log
window.toolbox_error.en: Couldn't open the Toolbox – details in the log

window.click_value.de: Klick auf den Wert kopiert ihn.
window.click_value.en: Click the value to copy it.

window.stopped_explained.de: „steht“: Der Anschluss wird angesteuert, aber nichts dreht sich – meist ist dort kein Lüfter angeschlossen, oder er stoppt gerade im Leerlauf.
window.stopped_explained.en: "stopped": the header is being driven, but nothing is spinning – usually no fan is connected there, or it is stopped while idle.

window.nothing_selected.de: Nichts markiert – Zeilen anklicken oder mit gedrückter Maustaste darüberziehen.
window.nothing_selected.en: Nothing selected – click rows or drag across them with the mouse button held down.

power.copy_table.help.en: Copies the bars of the chart as a table (period, kWh, cost, measured time) – tab-separated, e.g. for Excel.

power.hint.en: Hover over a bar for its values. Estimated: CPU and graphics card are measured, the rest of the PC is a fixed value (settings on the Toolbox page, ⚙).

power.note.off.en: Logging is off, so the chart stays empty. Switch on "Log power consumption" on the Toolbox page (⚙ at the top right) – from then on the consumption is added up while the Hardware Monitor runs.

power.note.empty.en: Logging is on – the first values appear in the chart within a few seconds.

power.note.on.en: Logged since {since} while the Hardware Monitor runs (estimated – the Toolbox page explains how).

power.help.now.en: Estimated power at the socket: CPU {cpu} W + graphics card {gpu} W + other components {other} W, divided by the power supply efficiency of {efficiency} % = {watts} W.

power.help.battery.en: Running on battery: this is what the whole laptop draws right now, measured by the battery.

power.help.today.en: Energy logged today and what it costs at the price from the settings.

power.help.month.en: Energy logged this month and what it costs at the price from the settings.

power.help.uptime.en: How long Windows has been running – the same as "Up time" in Task Manager. With Fast Startup a normal shutdown doesn't reset it, only a restart does.

power.bar.empty.en: {period}: nothing logged (PC off, Hardware Monitor not running or logging off)

fans.note.intro.en: Auto = the graphics card or the BIOS controls the fan, as without this program. Curve: the speed follows a temperature. Fixed: always the same speed. From the red temperature limit on, a controlled fan always runs at 100 %; when quitting, every fan is handed back.

fans.note.none.en: LibreHardwareMonitor can't control any fan on this PC – the graphics card or the chip on the motherboard doesn't allow it, or the Hardware Monitor runs without admin rights.

fans.note.crashed.en: ⚠ The Hardware Monitor ended last time while it controlled fans (crash, or ended in Task Manager). Until now they kept their last speed – a restart of Windows resets them for sure.

fans.list.help.en: Click a fan to set it below. All fans of a graphics card follow one curve together.

fans.mode.auto.help.en: Auto: the graphics card or the BIOS controls this fan – as without the Hardware Monitor.

fans.mode.curve.help.en: Curve: the speed follows the temperature along the curve below.

fans.mode.fixed.help.en: Fixed: always this speed – except from the red temperature limit on, then 100 %.

fans.source.help.en: Which temperature the fan follows: GPU, CPU or the higher of the two (good for case fans). It's the sensor of the taskbar icons; its red limit switches to 100 %.

fans.reset_curve.help.en: Replaces the curve with a quiet default curve.

fans.point.help.en: Point: {temp} °C → {pct} %. Drag to move it, right-click to remove it.

fans.editor.help.en: Drag a point to move it, double-click to add one, right-click a point to remove it. Changes apply right away.

fans.minimum.en: This fan doesn't run slower than {pct} % while it's controlled (shown as a line in the chart).

fans.minimum.gpu.en: The graphics card doesn't allow less than {pct} % while it's controlled (line in the chart). In Auto it can stop its fans completely when idle (0 RPM) – at idle that's usually quieter than any curve.

health.copy.help.en: Copies the data and the SMART table of this drive as text (in privacy mode without the serial number).

health.list.help.en: Click a drive to see its data and SMART values below.

health.hint.en: Status like CrystalDiskInfo: Good · Caution (e.g. reallocated, pending or uncorrectable sectors on a hard disk) · Bad (a value below its threshold, or the drive reports a critical warning). Raw values are hexadecimal. Read again every 10 s while this tab is open.

health.none.en: No drives found – reading the health needs admin rights (the Hardware Monitor normally has them).

explain.temp.tctl_tdie.de: Die Steuertemperatur des Prozessors, nach der Mainboard und Lüfter regeln – der wichtigste CPU-Wert.
explain.temp.tctl_tdie.en: The processor's control temperature that the motherboard and fans regulate by – the most important CPU value.

explain.temp.tctl.de: Steuertemperatur für die Lüfterregelung; bei einigen Ryzen-Modellen absichtlich um einen festen Wert höher als die echte Temperatur.
explain.temp.tctl.en: Control temperature for fan regulation; on some Ryzen models deliberately higher than the real temperature by a fixed offset.

explain.temp.tdie.de: Die tatsächliche Temperatur des Prozessor-Chips, ohne den Lüfter-Aufschlag von Tctl.
explain.temp.tdie.en: The actual temperature of the processor die, without the fan offset of Tctl.

explain.temp.ccd.de: Temperatur von Kern-Chip Nr. {0} (Core Complex Die) – hier sitzen die eigentlichen CPU-Kerne.
explain.temp.ccd.en: Temperature of core die no. {0} (Core Complex Die) – this is where the actual CPU cores are.

explain.temp.ccds_max.en: The highest value of all core dies (CCDs).

explain.temp.ccds_average.en: The average of all core dies (CCDs).

explain.temp.soc.de: Temperatur des I/O-Teils der CPU mit Speicher-Controller und PCIe-Anbindung.
explain.temp.soc.en: Temperature of the CPU's I/O part with the memory controller and PCIe connection.

explain.temp.cpu_package.de: Gesamttemperatur des Prozessors, meist so hoch wie der heißeste Kern – der wichtigste Wert bei Intel.
explain.temp.cpu_package.en: Overall processor temperature, usually as high as the hottest core – the most important value on Intel.

explain.temp.core_max.de: Die Temperatur des aktuell heißesten CPU-Kerns.
explain.temp.core_max.en: The temperature of the currently hottest CPU core.

explain.temp.core_average.en: The average across all CPU cores.

explain.temp.distance_tjmax.de: Abstand bis zu der Temperatur, ab der sich die CPU drosselt – hier ist ein höherer Wert besser.
explain.temp.distance_tjmax.en: Distance to the temperature at which the CPU throttles – a higher value is better here.

explain.temp.gpu_core.de: Die durchschnittliche Temperatur des Grafikchips – der klassische GPU-Wert.
explain.temp.gpu_core.en: The average temperature of the graphics chip – the classic GPU value.

explain.temp.gpu_hot_spot.de: Die heißeste Stelle auf dem Grafikchip; liegt normalerweise 10–20 °C über GPU Core, deutlich mehr kann auf schlechten Kühlerkontakt hindeuten.
explain.temp.gpu_hot_spot.en: The hottest spot on the graphics chip; normally 10–20 °C above GPU Core, much more can indicate poor cooler contact.

explain.temp.gpu_memory_junction.de: Die heißeste Stelle im Grafikspeicher (VRAM); unter Last sind hier Werte bis knapp 100 °C noch normal.
explain.temp.gpu_memory_junction.en: The hottest spot in the graphics memory (VRAM); under load, values up to just under 100 °C are still normal.

explain.temp.gpu_vr.de: Temperatur eines Spannungswandlers, der Grafikchip oder Speicher mit Strom versorgt.
explain.temp.gpu_vr.en: Temperature of a voltage regulator that powers the graphics chip or memory.

explain.temp.gpu_liquid.de: Temperatur der Kühlflüssigkeit bei wassergekühlten Grafikkarten.
explain.temp.gpu_liquid.en: Coolant temperature on water-cooled graphics cards.

explain.temp.motherboard_cpu.de: CPU-Temperatur, gemessen vom Sensor auf dem Mainboard – meist weniger genau als Tctl/Tdie.
explain.temp.motherboard_cpu.en: CPU temperature measured by the sensor on the motherboard – usually less accurate than Tctl/Tdie.

explain.temp.system.de: Temperatur auf dem Mainboard, ungefähr die Lufttemperatur im Gehäuse.
explain.temp.system.en: Temperature on the motherboard, roughly the air temperature inside the case.

explain.temp.chipset.de: Temperatur des Chipsatzes auf dem Mainboard.
explain.temp.chipset.en: Temperature of the chipset on the motherboard.

explain.temp.vrm.de: Temperatur der Spannungswandler, die die CPU mit Strom versorgen.
explain.temp.vrm.en: Temperature of the voltage regulators that power the CPU.

explain.temp.unnamed.de: Unbenannter Temperaturfühler Nr. {0}; was er misst, hängt vom Gerät ab (bei SSDs meist Controller bzw. Speicherchips).
explain.temp.unnamed.en: Unnamed temperature sensor no. {0}; what it measures depends on the device (on SSDs usually the controller or memory chips).

explain.temp.drive.en: Temperature of the drive (controller or memory chips).

explain.temp.composite.de: Zusammengefasste Temperatur der SSD, nach der sie sich ggf. drosselt.
explain.temp.composite.en: Combined temperature of the SSD, by which it throttles if necessary.

explain.temp.warning.de: Grenzwert der SSD: Ab dieser Temperatur warnt sie und beginnt sich zu drosseln – kein Messwert.
explain.temp.warning.en: SSD limit: from this temperature on it warns and starts to throttle – not a measured value.

explain.temp.critical.de: Grenzwert der SSD: Ab dieser Temperatur drosselt sie sich stark, um Schäden zu vermeiden – kein Messwert.
explain.temp.critical.en: SSD limit: from this temperature on it throttles heavily to prevent damage – not a measured value.

explain.load.cpu_total.en: Total load across all CPU cores.

explain.load.cpu_core_max.de: Auslastung des gerade am stärksten belasteten Kerns.
explain.load.cpu_core_max.en: Load of the currently most heavily loaded core.

explain.load.gpu_core.de: Wie stark die Recheneinheiten der Grafikkarte gerade arbeiten.
explain.load.gpu_core.en: How hard the graphics card's compute units are working right now.

explain.load.gpu_memory_controller.de: Auslastung der Anbindung zwischen Grafikchip und Grafikspeicher.
explain.load.gpu_memory_controller.en: Load of the connection between graphics chip and graphics memory.

explain.load.gpu_video_engine.de: Auslastung der Videoeinheit (Abspielen und Aufnehmen von Videos).
explain.load.gpu_video_engine.en: Load of the video unit (playing and recording videos).

explain.load.gpu_bus.de: Auslastung der PCIe-Verbindung zwischen Grafikkarte und Mainboard.
explain.load.gpu_bus.en: Load of the PCIe connection between graphics card and motherboard.

explain.load.gpu_memory.en: Share of the graphics memory (VRAM) in use.

explain.load.d3d.de: Auslastung laut Windows für diesen Teil der Grafikkarte (z. B. 3D, Kopieren, Video).
explain.load.d3d.en: Load according to Windows for this part of the graphics card (e.g. 3D, copy, video).

explain.load.memory.en: Share of the memory (RAM) in use.

explain.load.virtual_memory.de: Anteil des belegten Arbeitsspeichers inklusive Auslagerungsdatei.
explain.load.virtual_memory.en: Share of the memory in use, including the page file.

explain.load.activity.de: Wie viel Prozent der Zeit das Laufwerk gerade beschäftigt ist.
explain.load.activity.en: Percentage of time the drive is busy right now.

explain.load.network.de: Auslastung der Netzwerkverbindung im Verhältnis zu ihrer Maximalgeschwindigkeit.
explain.load.network.en: Load of the network connection relative to its maximum speed.

explain.clock.cpu_core.en: Current clock of CPU core no. {0}.

explain.clock.bus.de: Grundtakt, aus dem sich per Multiplikator der CPU-Takt ergibt (meist rund 100 MHz).
explain.clock.bus.en: Base clock from which the CPU clock results via the multiplier (usually around 100 MHz).

explain.clock.cores_average.en: Average clock of all CPU cores.

explain.clock.gpu_core.en: Current clock of the graphics chip.

explain.clock.gpu_memory.en: Current clock of the graphics memory.

explain.clock.gpu_shader.en: Clock of the graphics card's shader units.

explain.power.package.en: Total power draw of the processor.

explain.power.core_smu.de: Stromverbrauch von Kern Nr. {0}, gemeldet vom Prozessor selbst.
explain.power.core_smu.en: Power draw of core no. {0}, reported by the processor itself.

explain.power.cores.en: Power draw of all cores combined.

explain.power.soc.en: Power draw of the CPU's I/O part.

explain.power.cpu_memory.de: Stromverbrauch des Speicher-Controllers in der CPU.
explain.power.cpu_memory.en: Power draw of the memory controller in the CPU.

explain.power.platform.de: Stromverbrauch des ganzen Geräts laut Prozessor (CPU, Chipsatz, Speicher …) – nicht bei jedem Gerät verlässlich.
explain.power.platform.en: Power draw of the whole device according to the processor (CPU, chipset, memory …) – not reliable on every device.

explain.power.gpu.en: Total power draw of the graphics card.

explain.power.discharging.de: Leistung, die gerade aus dem Akku entnommen wird.
explain.power.discharging.en: Power currently being drawn from the battery.

explain.power.charging.de: Leistung, mit der der Akku gerade geladen wird.
explain.power.charging.en: Power with which the battery is currently being charged.

explain.voltage.core_svi.de: Kernspannung der CPU, gemeldet vom Spannungsregler.
explain.voltage.core_svi.en: CPU core voltage, reported by the voltage regulator.

explain.voltage.soc_svi.en: Voltage of the CPU's I/O part.

explain.voltage.vcore.de: Kernspannung der CPU, gemessen vom Mainboard.
explain.voltage.vcore.en: CPU core voltage, measured by the motherboard.

explain.voltage.psu_rail.de: Spannung der {0}-Volt-Leitung vom Netzteil; sollte nahe am Sollwert liegen (etwa ±5 %).
explain.voltage.psu_rail.en: Voltage of the {0} volt rail from the power supply; should be close to the nominal value (about ±5 %).

explain.voltage.cmos.de: Spannung der Knopfzelle auf dem Mainboard; liegt sie unter etwa 2,8 V, sollte sie bald getauscht werden.
explain.voltage.cmos.en: Voltage of the coin cell on the motherboard; if it is below about 2.8 V, it should be replaced soon.

explain.battery.discharge_current.de: Strom, der gerade aus dem Akku fließt.
explain.battery.discharge_current.en: Current flowing out of the battery right now.

explain.battery.charge_current.de: Strom, mit dem der Akku gerade geladen wird.
explain.battery.charge_current.en: Current with which the battery is currently being charged.

explain.battery.remaining.de: Energie, die gerade noch im Akku steckt.
explain.battery.remaining.en: Energy currently left in the battery.

explain.battery.full_charge.de: Energie, die der Akku heute voll geladen speichert – sinkt mit dem Alter.
explain.battery.full_charge.en: Energy the battery stores today when fully charged – decreases with age.

explain.battery.design.de: Energie, die der Akku laut Hersteller im Neuzustand speichert.
explain.battery.design.en: Energy the battery stores when new, according to the manufacturer.

explain.battery.remaining_time.de: Geschätzte Restlaufzeit bei der aktuellen Leistungsaufnahme.
explain.battery.remaining_time.en: Estimated remaining runtime at the current power draw.

explain.fan.gpu.de: Drehzahl des Grafikkarten-Lüfters; 0 RPM im Leerlauf ist normal, viele Karten stoppen ihre Lüfter dann.
explain.fan.gpu.en: Speed of the graphics card fan; 0 RPM at idle is normal, many cards stop their fans then.

explain.fan.motherboard.de: Drehzahl des Lüfteranschlusses Nr. {0} auf dem Mainboard.
explain.fan.motherboard.en: Speed of fan header no. {0} on the motherboard.

explain.fan.pump.en: Speed of a water cooling pump.

explain.fan.gpu_control.de: Wie stark der Grafikkarten-Lüfter angesteuert wird (Prozent der Maximaldrehzahl).
explain.fan.gpu_control.en: How strongly the graphics card fan is driven (percent of maximum speed).

explain.fan.motherboard_control.de: Wie stark der Lüfteranschluss auf dem Mainboard angesteuert wird.
explain.fan.motherboard_control.en: How strongly the fan header on the motherboard is driven.

explain.data.virtual_used.de: Belegter Arbeitsspeicher inklusive Auslagerungsdatei auf der SSD.
explain.data.virtual_used.en: Memory in use, including the page file on the SSD.

explain.data.virtual_available.en: Free memory, including the page file.

explain.data.read.de: Insgesamt von diesem Laufwerk gelesene Datenmenge über seine ganze Lebensdauer.
explain.data.read.en: Total amount of data read from this drive over its entire lifetime.

explain.data.written.de: Insgesamt auf dieses Laufwerk geschriebene Datenmenge über seine ganze Lebensdauer.
explain.data.written.en: Total amount of data written to this drive over its entire lifetime.

explain.data.uploaded.de: Hochgeladene Datenmenge seit dem Verbinden des Adapters.
explain.data.uploaded.en: Amount of data uploaded since the adapter connected.

explain.data.downloaded.de: Heruntergeladene Datenmenge seit dem Verbinden des Adapters.
explain.data.downloaded.en: Amount of data downloaded since the adapter connected.

explain.data.gpu_total.en: Total size of the graphics memory (VRAM).

explain.data.d3d_dedicated.en: Graphics memory currently used by Windows programs.

explain.data.d3d_shared_used.de: Arbeitsspeicher, den die Grafikkarte zusätzlich mitbenutzt – steigt, wenn der Grafikspeicher knapp wird. Bei Onboard-Grafik ohne eigenen Grafikspeicher ist das ihr ganzer Speicher.
explain.data.d3d_shared_used.en: Memory (RAM) the graphics card uses in addition – rises when graphics memory runs low. For integrated graphics without its own graphics memory, this is all of its memory.

explain.data.d3d_shared_free.de: Arbeitsspeicher, den die Grafik noch zusätzlich belegen dürfte.
explain.data.d3d_shared_free.en: Memory (RAM) the graphics could still use in addition.

explain.data.d3d_shared_total.de: Wie viel Arbeitsspeicher Windows der Grafik höchstens überlässt (meist die Hälfte).
explain.data.d3d_shared_total.en: The most memory (RAM) Windows leaves to the graphics (usually half).

explain.throughput.read.en: Current read speed of the drive.

explain.throughput.write.en: Current write speed of the drive.

explain.throughput.pcie_rx.de: Daten, die die Grafikkarte gerade über PCIe empfängt.
explain.throughput.pcie_rx.en: Data the graphics card is currently receiving via PCIe.

explain.throughput.pcie_tx.de: Daten, die die Grafikkarte gerade über PCIe sendet.
explain.throughput.pcie_tx.en: Data the graphics card is currently sending via PCIe.

explain.level.spare.de: Reserve-Speicherzellen der SSD für defekte Zellen; sinkt im Laufe der Zeit.
explain.level.spare.en: Spare memory cells of the SSD for defective cells; decreases over time.

explain.level.spare_threshold.de: Grenzwert: Fällt die Reserve (Available Spare) darunter, meldet die SSD einen kritischen Zustand – kein Messwert.
explain.level.spare_threshold.en: Limit: if the spare (Available Spare) drops below it, the SSD reports a critical state – not a measured value.

explain.level.life.en: Estimated remaining lifetime of the SSD.

explain.level.used.de: Verbrauchter Anteil der vom Hersteller angegebenen Lebensdauer der SSD.
explain.level.used.en: Used share of the SSD's lifetime specified by the manufacturer.

explain.level.wear.de: Wie stark der Akku gegenüber neu an Kapazität verloren hat.
explain.level.wear.en: How much capacity the battery has lost compared to new.

explain.counter.power_on_count.de: Wie oft das Laufwerk insgesamt eingeschaltet wurde.
explain.counter.power_on_count.en: How often the drive has been switched on in total.

explain.counter.power_on_hours.de: Betriebsstunden des Laufwerks über seine ganze Lebensdauer.
explain.counter.power_on_hours.en: Operating hours of the drive over its entire lifetime.

explain.type.Temperature.en: A temperature sensor of this component.

explain.type.Clock.de: Taktfrequenz in Megahertz (Millionen Takte pro Sekunde).
explain.type.Clock.en: Clock frequency in megahertz (million cycles per second).

explain.type.Energy.en: An amount of energy in watt-hours.

explain.type.TimeSpan.de: Eine Zeitdauer in Stunden und Minuten.
explain.type.TimeSpan.en: A duration in hours and minutes.

explain.type.Fan.en: Fan speed in revolutions per minute.

explain.type.Control.de: Ansteuerung eines Lüfters oder einer Pumpe in Prozent.
explain.type.Control.en: Control of a fan or pump in percent.

explain.type.Level.en: Fill level or condition in percent.

hw.overview.help.de: Nur die Modellnamen aller Komponenten, nach Bereichen sortiert.
hw.overview.help.en: Only the model names of all components, sorted by category.

hw.details.help.de: Alle Hardwaredaten: Hersteller, Modell, IDs, Seriennummern, Treiber.
hw.details.help.en: All hardware data: manufacturer, model, IDs, serial numbers, drivers.

hw.copy_all.overview.en: Copies all model names as text.

hw.copy_all.details.de: Kopiert alle Hardwaredaten als Text (mit Computername und Datum).
hw.copy_all.details.en: Copies all hardware data as text (with computer name and date).

hw.copy.overview.de: Kopiert die Modellnamen zu „{category}“ als Text.
hw.copy.overview.en: Copies the model names for "{category}" as text.

hw.copy.details.de: Kopiert alle Daten zu „{category}“ als Text.
hw.copy.details.en: Copies all data for "{category}" as text.

hw.not_read_yet.de: Die Hardwaredaten werden noch gelesen – gleich noch einmal versuchen.
hw.not_read_yet.en: The hardware data is still being read – try again in a moment.

hw.no_data.en: No hardware data found (details in data\logs\hardware_monitor.log).

hw.explain.vendor_id.de: Kennung des Chip-Herstellers (Vendor ID), z. B. 10DE = Nvidia. Weltweit eindeutig vergeben.
hw.explain.vendor_id.en: ID of the chip manufacturer (vendor ID), e.g. 10DE = Nvidia. Assigned uniquely worldwide.

hw.explain.product_id.de: Kennung des Chips beim Hersteller (Device ID bzw. bei USB Product ID).
hw.explain.product_id.en: ID of the chip at its manufacturer (device ID, or product ID for USB).

hw.explain.board_vendor.de: Wer die Karte gebaut hat (Subsystem Vendor ID) – bei Grafikkarten z. B. Asus oder MSI, auch wenn der Chip von Nvidia ist.
hw.explain.board_vendor.en: Who built the card (subsystem vendor ID) – for graphics cards e.g. Asus or MSI, even if the chip is from Nvidia.

hw.explain.subsystem_id.de: Kennung des genauen Kartenmodells beim Platinen-Hersteller.
hw.explain.subsystem_id.en: ID of the exact card model at the board manufacturer.

hw.explain.hardware_id.de: Vollständige Kennung, unter der Windows das Gerät führt – gut für die Treibersuche.
hw.explain.hardware_id.en: Full ID under which Windows lists the device – useful for finding drivers.

hw.explain.processor_id.de: CPUID-Kennung: Merkmale, Familie, Modell und Stepping des Prozessors (keine Seriennummer).
hw.explain.processor_id.en: CPUID: features, family, model and stepping of the processor (not a serial number).

hw.explain.mac_address.en: The fixed hardware address of the network adapter.

hw.explain.serial_number.de: Seriennummer laut Gerät; fehlt, wenn der Hersteller keine hinterlegt hat.
hw.explain.serial_number.en: Serial number reported by the device; missing if the manufacturer didn't store one.

hw.explain.part_number.de: Bestellnummer des Herstellers – damit findet man genau diesen Riegel wieder.
hw.explain.part_number.en: The manufacturer's part number – use it to find exactly this module again.

hw.explain.speed.de: Eingestellter Speichertakt in Megatransfers pro Sekunde.
hw.explain.speed.en: Configured memory speed in megatransfers per second.

hw.explain.rated_speed.de: Höchster Takt, den der Riegel ohne XMP/EXPO meldet.
hw.explain.rated_speed.en: Highest speed the module reports without XMP/EXPO.

hw.explain.form_factor.de: Riegel lassen sich tauschen und aufrüsten; verlöteter Speicher sitzt fest auf dem Mainboard.
hw.explain.form_factor.en: Modules can be swapped and upgraded; soldered memory is fixed to the motherboard.

hw.explain.channels.de: Verlöteten Speicher meldet Windows je Speicherkanal statt je Riegel – so viele Einträge sind es.
hw.explain.channels.en: Windows reports soldered memory per memory channel instead of per module – this is how many entries there are.
